(i) KagNet is a novel knowledge aware neural graph module, which is capable of representing and reasoning over knowledge graphs, and (ii) KagNet based textual inference framework is capable of achieving state of the art results on the Commonsense QA dataset.

(1) Commonsense knowledge graphs can help to answer questions in a textual inference task, and (2) a hierarchical attention based knowledge aware graph network model can achieve state of the art results in this task.
